title: Paper launch film — marker notes, bouncing ball, one chat

source.author: @ik_builds
source.note: The first remake (trial of 2026-09-30), rebranded and turned into a template. Structure and pacing follow the Mebbian launch film; copy and brand are ours. The end-card icon is the image-frame mark from public/imgs/claude-imagine/logo-alpha.png.

scenes: ball drops onto a paper line with onion-skin ghosts and a trail
marker notes and four cards (prompt, moodboard, sticky, shot list) arrive
hard cut to dark, the cards are pulled into the ball
kinetic two-line headline falls letter by letter, scatters
chart: flat 'text only' line vs an S-curve 'images + video', bracket note
the ball arcs into the end card and lands as the sun of the icon, wordmark, tagline, circled URL
render: npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4 --variables '{"line1":"ACME STUDIO","line2":"SHIPS IT ALL","wordmark":"Acme Studio","url":"acme.studio","disclaimer":""}'
